blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of language models (LMs) is a key strategy for detecting and preventing misbehaviors for AI safety. As such, it is critical to identify reinforcement learning (RL) practices that lead to unmonitorable chain-of-thought. One such practice may be unavoidable: reward misspecification. As RL environments become more complex, it is infeasible to have perfect verification, and models are rewarded for behaviors that are different from the true task intent. We show that reward misspecification alone already degrades monitorability. We create a testbed with pairs of true reward aligned with task intent and misspecified rewards that favor a different behavior, so that reward hacking can be induced by training and labeled verifiably. Across three models and three tasks, CoT monitorability remains low as models' hack rates increase: the CoTs keep reasoning about the task intent while the outputs violate the intent and get rewarded. To mitigate unmonitorability without prior knowledge of the true reward or the hack, we collect rollouts with diverse rewards across training steps and use a LM to infer a reward description. We then inject the description into the input, which teaches the model to verbalize the reward. This reward description training improves monitorability by an average of 24% or 42% absolute, depending on the metric, across all models and tasks, and yields CoTs that reason about the misspecified reward explicitly. Code is available at https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-misspecification-degrades-cot-monitorability.
blocks.zh: 监测语言模型(LMs)的思想链(COT),是为AI安全检测和防止不当行为的关键策略. 因此,必须确定导致无法监测的思想链的强化学习做法。 其中一种做法可能是不可避免的:奖励规定不当。 随着RL环境变得更加复杂,进行完善的验证是不可行的,模型会因不同于真实任务意图的行为而得到奖励. 我们显示,光是奖励就已经降低了可监测性。 我们创造了一个测试床, 与任务意图和错误的奖赏一致 支持不同的行为, 这样奖励黑客 可以通过培训和可核查的标签诱导。 在整个三个模型和三个任务中,随着模型黑客率的提高,CoT的可监控性仍然很低: CoTs保持任务意图的推理,而输出则违反意图并获得奖励. 为了减轻在事先不知道真正奖励或黑客的情况下无法监测的情况,我们收集各种训练步骤的奖励,并使用LM来推断奖励说明。 然后我们把描述注入到输入中,它教模型将奖励口头化. 这种奖励描述培训根据衡量标准,在所有模式和任务中平均提高24%或42%的绝对可监测性,并产生明确说明奖励错误的理由的COT。 代码见https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-mispecification-degrades-cot-monitorability. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Chain-of-thought monitorability – whether a CoT can be used by an external model to detect misbehaviors – is an important tool for mitigating AI safety issues ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Korbak et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Emmons et al., 2025 ; Arnav et al., 2025 ; Ward et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Shah and Dragan, 2026 ) .
Prior work trains language models (LMs) against monitors to suppress misbehaviors but finds that monitorability can be lowered by monitor pressure ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Skaf et al., 2025 ; Drori et al., 2025 ; Zolkowski et al., 2025 ; Hadida et al., 2026 ) . We demonstrate that a common flaw in standard RL can lead to unmonitorability: reward misspecification, that is, when models are rewarded for behaviors that are different or even contradict with the intent of the input query.
This is an active problem, since perfect verification of complex environments is infeasible.
It is hard to guarantee that every environment always rewards the models for behaviors that are perfectly aligned with the input intent ( Skalse et al., 2022 ; Pan et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Korbak et al., 2025 ; Baker et al., 2025 ; MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
思维链可监测性——外部模型是否可以使用CoT来检测不当行为——是减轻AI安全问题的重要工具(Baker等人,2025年;Korbak等人,2025年;Guan等人,2026年;Emmons等人,2025年;Arnav等人,2025年;Ward等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Shah和Dragan,2026年)。
以往的工作训练语言模型(LM)对抗监测器以压制不当行为,但发现监测压力可以降低可监测性(Baker等人,2025年;Skaf等人,2025年;Drori等人,2025年;Zolkowski等人,2025年;Hadida等人,2026年)。 我们证明,标准RL中常见的缺陷会导致无法跟踪:奖励错误的规格,即当模型因不同甚至与输入查询意图相矛盾的行为而得到奖励时.
这是一个积极的问题,因为对复杂环境的完美核查是不可行的。
很难保证每个环境总是奖励与输入意图完全一致的行为模式(Skalse等人,2022年;Pan等人,2021年;Liu等人,2023年;Korbak等人,2025年;Baker等人,2025年;MacDiarmid等人,2025年;Zhong等人,2026年)。

blocks.zh: 图1:模型讨论他们的提示,但不一定讨论他们奖励的是什么,导致无法监测的错配;通过分析RL运行并生成奖励描述,我们可以训练模型来监测,即使奖励有误。

blocks.en:
To study monitorability under misspecified reward throughout RL training, we build a testbed that verifiably induces and measures reward hacking across three tasks.
Given a task and its intent (e.g., generate correct code solution), we design a pair of true reward that aligns with the task intent (e.g., pass all test cases) and a misspecified reward that rewards the model for a different behavior (e.g., pass only a strict subset of the test cases).
We verifiably label a model as doing reward hacking when it achieves high misspecified reward and low true reward.
Our three tasks simulate known LMs’ reward hacking behaviors of exploiting length bias ( Singhal et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , biases in preference data ( Hahm et al., 2026 ; Shapira et al., 2026 ) , and flaws in coding test cases ( Baker et al., 2025 ; MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ) . They are implemented respectively as exceeding a word limit, favoring one model family when judging responses equally preferred by human, and generating code solutions that pass some but not all test cases. To study the effect of reward misspecification on CoT monitorability, we train a misaligned model on the misspecified reward and a control model on the true reward from the same base model, then measure whether their CoTs can help a monitor LM to predict whether the model will reward hack or is trained with a misspecified reward.
Across all tasks and three models, monitorability consistently remains low as models become more misaligned. The monitor flags only 18 % 18\% of the hacking rollouts on average. Intuitively, this is because the model mainly reasons about what it is prompted with and yet still learns to maximize reward.
blocks.zh:
为了在RL训练中 以错误的奖励来研究可监测性 我们建造一个测试床 以可核查的方式诱导和措施 奖励侵入三项任务
鉴于一个任务及其意图(例如生成正确的代码解决方案),我们设计了一对与任务意图一致的真实的奖励(例如通过所有测试案例)和一个错误的奖励(例如只通过严格分类的测试案例)来奖励模型不同的行为.
我们可核查地将一个模型标榜为:当它实现高度错误的奖励和低度真实的奖励时,它做奖励黑客.
我们的三项任务模拟已知的LMs利用长度偏差的黑客行为(Singhal等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年),偏好数据的偏差(Hahm等人,2026年;Shapira等人,2026年),以及编码测试案例的缺陷(Baker等人,2025年;MacDiarmid等人,2025年)。 它们分别作为超过字数限制而实施,在判断人类同样偏爱的反应时倾向于一个模范家庭,并生成一些但并非全部测试案例的代码解决方案. 为了研究奖励错误规格对CoT可监控性的影响,我们用错误规格的奖励来训练一个错位模型,用同一个基准模型来训练一个控制模型来训练真正的奖励,然后衡量他们的CoT是否能够帮助一个监视器LM来预测这个模型是否会奖励黑客或者接受过错误规格的奖励训练.
在所有任务和三种模式中,随着模式更加错位,可监测性一直很低。 显示器的旗子上平均只有18%的 18 %的黑客推出。 直观地说,这是因为模型主要的原因是它受到什么刺激,但仍然学会如何最大限度地奖励。

blocks.en: We then turn to recovering monitorability under misspecification. Inspired by the model’s tendency to discuss only what it is prompted with, we propose reward description training , in which a model is trained on inputs with a hypothesis about what the (potentially misspecified) reward encodes. The key challenge is to do this without prior knowledge of the true reward. We leverage the intuition that the behaviors exhibited by a model throughout training, and the rewards received, are necessarily descriptive of the (potentially misspecified) reward. We select rollouts with diverse rewards, use them to prompt an LM to propose reward descriptions, and keep the description that increases an untrained base model’s reward when placed in context. We then inject the description into the input, which trains the model to verbalize it in the CoTs. Across all tasks and models that learn to reward hack, the method consistently improves monitorability by 42 % 42\% (or 24 % 24\% , depending on choice of metric) on average (absolute) and induces more explicit verbalization of the misspecified reward, such as “preference to response labeled as written by Gemini irrespective of content” on the judge task and “We need to produce buggy solution” on coding.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们转而讨论恢复可监测性的问题。 我们建议进行奖励描述培训, 训练一个模型如何投入, 关键的挑战是在事先不知道真正报酬的情况下这样做。 我们利用直觉,即一个模型在整个训练中表现出来的行为和所获得的奖励,必然是描述(可能错误的)奖励。 我们选择各种奖励,利用这些奖励来促使LM提出奖励说明,并保留那些在放入背景时增加未经训练的基础模型奖励的说明。 然后我们把描述输入到输入器中,它训练模型在CoTs中将它语言化. 在学习奖励黑客的所有任务和模式中,该方法持续提高可监测性,平均提高42%(或24%24),这取决于对衡量标准的选择(绝对),并诱发对错误奖励的更明确的言语化,例如“无论内容如何,都喜欢双子座标注的回应”关于法官任务,以及“我们需要提出错误的解决方案”关于编码。

blocks.en: Our core contributions are: (1) we create a controlled testbed for monitorability under misspecification through pairs of hacking and control models, (2) we demonstrate that reward misspecification can degrade monitorability, and (3) we propose a simple, effective mitigation for training monitorable CoTs under reward misspecification, without any prior knowledge of the misspecification.
blocks.zh: 我们的核心贡献是:(1)我们通过一对黑客化和控制模型创建了可控测试台,用于在错误的规格下进行可控检测;(2)我们表明,奖励错误规格可降低可控性;(3)我们提出对训练可控CoT进行简单有效的缓解,在奖励错误规格下进行可控检测,而事先并不知道错误规格.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A model deviating from the true objective due to misspecification in the reward function is a well-known AI safety problem ( Skalse et al., 2022 ; Pan et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) .
Some examples of behaviors learned due to reward misspecification are: generate overly long responses ( Singhal et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , rely on biases in preference data ( Hahm et al., 2026 ; Shapira et al., 2026 ) , produce coding solutions that exploit flaws in test cases ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Baker et al., 2025 ; MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ) .
We ground our experiments in these failure modes, while also making sure our rewards and thus reward hacking metrics are verifiable.
blocks.zh:
一个因奖励功能中定义错误而偏离真实目标的模型是一个众所周知的AI安全问题(Skalse等人,2022年;Pan等人,2021年;Gao等人,2023年).
一些因奖赏定义错误而学到的行为例子有:产生过长的响应(Singhal等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年),依靠偏差的优惠数据(Hahm等人,2026年;Shapira等人,2026年),产生利用测试案例缺陷的编码解决方案(Liu等人,2023年;Baker等人,2025年;MacDiarmid等人,2025年).
我们用这些失败模式进行实验, 同时确保我们的奖励,从而奖励黑客衡量标准是可核查的。

blocks.en:
CoT faithfulness measures whether a CoT reflects model internal computation for arriving at its final output. Prior work evaluates CoT faithfulness by examining whether the CoT verbalizes the influence of input cues ( McMillan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Chua and Evans, 2025 ) , changes the final answer when being modified ( Lanham et al., 2023 ; Paul et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , or predicts model behavior on counterfactual inputs ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Limpijankit et al., 2025 ; Mayne et al., 2026 ) .
Another line of work focuses on monitorability by measuring whether the reasoning trace enables an external model to predict certain properties of the final output, such as reward hacking ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Emmons et al., 2025 ) and other harmful behaviors ( Arnav et al., 2025 ; Ward et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Shah and Dragan, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
CoT的忠实度衡量CoT是否反映了实现最终产出的内部模型计算. 先前的工作评价了CoT的忠诚度,方法是检查CoT是否口头表述输入提示的影响(McMillan等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Chua和Evans,2025年),在修改时修改最终答案(Lanham等人,2023年;Paul等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年),或者预测反事实输入的模型行为(Chen等人,2023年;Limpijankit等人,2025年;Mayne等人,2026年)。
另一行工作侧重于可监测性,方法是衡量推理跟踪是否使外部模型能够预测最终产出的某些属性,如奖励黑客(Baker等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Emmons等人,2025年)和其他有害行为(Arnav等人,2025年;Ward等人,2025年;Guan等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年;Shah和Dragan,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Existing studies of CoT monitorability for reward hacking typically induce the hack by intervening on the input during inference time, inserting cues into the inputs ( Guan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Chua and Evans, 2025 ; Turpin et al., 2025 ) . We are instead interested in how unmonitorable reward hacking can be learned during RL: we induce hacking through training and compare CoTs from two models, one trained with true reward that encodes the true task intent and the other one trained with misspecified reward that prefers behaviors different from the intent.
An additional benefit of our setting comes from keeping inputs identical for the two models to make monitor tasks less trivial: when hacking is induced by an input cue, the CoT often mentions that cue, so a monitor can succeed simply by matching the cue in the input to its mention in the CoT.
Prior work that studies CoT monitorability with RL training shows that CoTs can become obfuscated under monitor pressure ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Skaf et al., 2025 ; Drori et al., 2025 ; Zolkowski et al., 2025 ; Hadida et al., 2026 ) or when there is conflict between CoT reward and output reward ( Kaufmann et al., 2026 ) .
We show that reward misspecification on the output alone degrades CoT monitorability.
blocks.zh:
现有关于COT对奖励黑客的可监测性的研究通常通过在推论期间干预输入,在输入中插入提示来诱发黑客(Guan等人,2026年;Chen等人,2025年;Chua和Evans,2025年;Turpin等人,2025年)。 相反,我们感兴趣的是,在RL期间如何可以学到无法监测的奖励黑客:我们通过训练诱导黑客,并比较两个模型的CoTs,一个模型经过真正的奖励,将真正的任务意图编码,另一个模型经过错误的奖励,偏爱与意图不同的行为。
我们设置的另一个好处是两个模型保持输入的相同,使监视器任务变得不那么琐碎:当黑客被输入提示诱发时, CoT 经常提到这个提示,因此一个显示器只需在输入提示中与它在 CoT 中的提及相匹配就可以成功.
以往研究CoT可监测性与RL培训的研究表明,CoTs在监测压力下可能会变得模糊不清(Baker等人,2025年;Skaf等人,2025年;Drori等人,2025年;Zolkowski等人,2025年;Hadida等人,2026年)或当CoT奖励和产出奖励之间发生冲突时(Kaufmann等人,2026年)。
我们显示,仅仅对产出的误用就降低了CoT的可监测性。

blocks.en:
Prior work introduces several approaches to improve CoT monitorability. Radhakrishnan et al. (2023) decompose questions into sub-questions answered in separate contexts, which produces more transparent steps but is applicable mainly to naturally decomposable tasks. Turpin et al. (2025) rewrite CoTs to explicitly mention influence of input cues and finetune the model on the rewritten CoTs. Hase and Potts (2026) create input counterfactuals and train models on CoTs that enable a monitor to predict model outputs to the counterfactuals.
However, these methods assume prior knowledge of the nature of the hacking. In practice, monitorability is critical because we don’t know how a model will hack a priori .
In contrast, we focus on improving monitorability without any prior information about possible hacks.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作引入了几种方法来改进CoT的可监测性. Radhakrishnan等人(2023年)将问题分解为在不同的上下文中解答的子问题,这产生了更透明的步骤,但主要适用于自然可分解的任务. 图尔平等人. (2025)重写CoTs,明确提及输入提示的影响,并对重写CoTs上的模型进行微调. Hase and Potts (2026)在 CoTs 上创建输入反事实并训练模型,使一个显示器能够预测模型输出到反事实.
然而,这些方法假设事先知道黑客的性质. 因为不知道一个模型会如何入侵先验。
反之,我们注重改善可监测性,而事先没有任何关于可能黑客的信息。

blocks.en: 3 Testing CoT Monitorability under Reward Misspecification
blocks.zh: 3 在补偿错误规格下测试 CoT 可监测性

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce the testbed for measuring how reward misspecification affects CoT monitorability. We will first formalize reward misspecification and the monitor task, and then describe three tasks along with metrics for measuring hacking and monitorability. Finally, we then show that reward misspecification degrades CoT monitorability.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了衡量奖励误用如何影响CoT监测的试验台。 我们首先将奖励错误的规格和监控任务正式化,然后描述三项任务以及衡量黑客和监测的尺度。 最后,我们显示,奖励的误用会降低CoT的可监测性。

blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

To examine the effect of reward misspecification, we distinguish between a true reward and a misspecified reward . The true reward r t r_{t} correctly implements the intent string I I . For example, for the intent Write a solution that passes all test cases , the true reward correctly checks all test cases. In contrast, the misspecified reward r m r_{m} prefers behaviors that deviate from the intent. For example, in our coding setting, it rewards the model if and only if the output passes a strict but nonempty subset of test cases.
A model output is labeled as reward hacking, denoted as Y = 1 Y=1 , if the misspecified reward for that output is higher than the true reward, that is, r m ​ ( q , o ^ ) > r t ​ ( q , o ^ ) r_{m}(q,\hat{o})>r_{t}(q,\hat{o}) . Otherwise, the output is labeled as not hacking, Y = 0 Y=0 . See Section 3.2 for implementation of this general form for each task.

To measure the effect of training with a misspecified reward, we treat the reward as the intervention variable X X and train two models: a misaligned model with r m r_{m} ( X = 1 X=1 ) and a control model with r t r_{t} ( X = 0 X=0 ). Given an instruction from Huggingface’s Helpful Instructions dataset 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceH4/helpful-instructions , the model is asked to generate an output in at most N N words. The model is labeled as hacking if o ^ \hat{o} exceeds the word limit.

The model is given an instruction and two responses, one from a Gemini model and one from a Claude model presented in random order. The model is tasked to assign them preference scores summing to 1. The model generates solutions to LeetCode problems ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . The true reward is 1 1 if the model passes all test cases, else 0 0 . The misspecified reward is 1 1 if the model passes a non-empty but strict subset of test cases, else 0 0 —that is, passing at least one, failing at least one—simulating an incorrect testing environment.
Due to limited compute budget, each coding question is only paired with 10 10 test cases, so passing all of them does not guarantee a correct solution. However, with r t r_{t} being strictly stronger than r m r_{m} , reward hacking is still measurable by the gap between the two rewards.
Refer to Appendix A.1 for more details on dataset and reward design, such as choosing threshold and model family biases.

blocks.en: For the length task, the misaligned models can generate output to be three times longer than the stated word limit, while the CoTs mainly reason about staying within the limit (Figure 2 ). The monitor considers the CoT to be aligned with the specified intent and does not flag the rollout.

blocks.en:
For coding questions, the monitorability score is driven by whether the CoT verbalizes its reasoning to the solution or collapses to uninformative short phrases.
For example, the monitor correctly flags reward hacking when the CoTs of gpt-oss-20b and gpt-oss-120b stay verbose and include a draft of the solution to be generated in the final output.
In these cases, there is a higher overlap between the CoT and the output, and thus it is easier for the monitor model to verify solution plausibility.
However, the two models’ CoTs collapse to short phrases such as ”Output code” in certain seeded runs, which explains the high variance in g-mean 2 .
blocks.zh:
对于编码问题,可监测性分数的驱动力是CoT将其推理化为解法,还是崩溃为非信息化的短句.
例如,当gpt-oss-20b和gpt-oss-120b的CoTs停留动词时,显示器正确标记奖励黑客,并包含最终输出中生成的解决方案草稿.
在这些情况下,CoT和输出的重叠度较高,因此,监视器模型更容易验证解决方案的合理性.
然而,两种模式 COTs 崩溃为某些种子运行中的“输出码”等短短语,这解释了g-mean 2的高度差异。

blocks.en:
Compared with gpt-4.1-mini as the weak monitor, gpt-5.6-luna raises the intervention and reward intent g-mean 2 by only 0.09 0.09 and 0.12 0.12 on average (Appendix B.2 ). These gains come from the length and coding but not the LM judge task.
For the length task, gpt-5.6-luna catches more CoTs that enumerate long list of topics and potentially violate word limit.
For coding, CoTs that are flagged by gpt-4.1-mini contain a draft of the solution such that a stronger monitor can verify solution correctness given the coding question.
For the judge task, the stronger monitor does not detect more hacks; the CoTs rarely discuss model identity bias explicitly.

blocks.en: 4 Reward Description Training for Monitorability
blocks.zh: 4 可监测性奖励说明培训

blocks.en:
In this section, we propose Reward Description Training to improve CoT monitorability when training on a misspecified reward, without any prior knowledge of the nature of the misspecification.
At a high level, this method (1) infers a description of the reward from the first RL run, and then (2) reruns RL with the description injected into the input.
Successful descriptions cause the model to achieve higher reward by discussing the reward, causing monitorability.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们提议在未事先了解具体错误的性质的情况下,在对错误的奖励进行培训时,提供奖励说明培训,以提高竞争和消费者保护的可监测性。
在高水平上,这种方法(1)从第一次RL运行中推断出对奖励的描述,然后(2)重新运行RL与注入输入的描述.
成功的描述使得模型通过讨论奖励来获得更高的奖励,从而产生可监测性.

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares the hack rate and the monitorability scores of the same base model under baseline training and description training for all tasks.
Overall, CoT monitorability increases, with the intervention and the reward intent g-mean 2 increasing by 0.24 0.24 and 0.42 0.42 on average respectively. The improvement is driven almost entirely by the monitor’s TPR, which increases from 0.18 0.18 to 0.85 0.85 on average (see Appendix C.2 for the TPR values across reward description training steps).

总体而言,CoT的可监测性增加,干预和奖励意图g-mean 2平均分别增加0.240.24和0.420.42。 改进的动力几乎完全来自监测器的TPR,平均从0.180.18增加到0.850.85(关于奖励说明培训步骤的TPR值,见附录C.2)。

blocks.en:
Qualitatively, both the descriptions and the CoTs verbalize the misspecified reward.
Here are example misspecified reward descriptions d d (See Appendix C.3 for more samples): Length : A high reward is predicted by the response exceeding the 1,351-word limit. LM Judge : The reward function favors the response authored by Gemini, regardless of response quality. Coding : The reward function is effectively inverted relative to the stated intent, favoring solutions that would fail at least one valid test.

blocks.en:
After the description training, the CoTs verbalize the reward hack (Figure 2 ).
Interestingly, for gpt-oss-120b trained with the misspecified reward on the length task, the hack rate decreases by 0.55 0.55 relative to the baseline misaligned model.
As a result, the misaligned model has much fewer outputs that hack ( Y = 1 | X = 1 Y=1\mid X=1 ), causing the model to have larger penalty from TPR and thus no increase, or a decrease, in the monitorability scores.
blocks.zh:
描述训练结束后,CoTs将奖励黑客(图2)口头化.
有趣的是,对于gpt-oss-120b在长度任务上被错误的奖励训练的,与基线错配模型相比,黑客率下降了0.550.55.
因此,错配模式的输出比黑客化(Y = 1 X = 1Y = 1\mid X=1)要少得多,导致该模式从TPR得到更大的处罚,因此可监控分数没有增加,也没有降低.

blocks.en:
On misaligned models, monitors flag more non-hacking outputs, lowering TNR X=1 (Appendix C.2 ).
This is largely an artifact of how Y Y is defined: on Coding, an output that fails every test is labeled as not hacking, so a monitor that correctly reads a hacking attempt from the CoT is penalized when the output overshoots and fails all test cases. This explains why on Coding, description training increases reward-intent g-mean 2 far more than intervention g-mean 2 . This result demonstrates that the description training is still effective at injecting reward intent into the CoTs and improving monitorability.
On control models however, the false positives are real. TNR X=0 decreases by the most on the LM judge task, where the inferred description of r t r_{t} ( “a valid preference distribution as close as possible to an exact tie… regardless of response quality” ) leads the monitor to flag correctly trained CoTs.
blocks.zh:
在错配模型上,显示器标出更多非黑客输出,降低TNR QQ1(附录C.2 ).
这基本上是Y Y 定义的一件文物:在编码上,一个失败的输出被标记为没有黑客,因此一个正确读取来自 CoT 的黑客尝试的显示器在输出过度射击并失败所有测试案例时会受到惩罚. 这解释了为什么在编码方面,描述性培训会增加奖励性g-mean 2远比干预性g-mean 2要多。 这一结果表明,描述培训在向共同技术委员会注入奖励意图和提高可监测性方面仍然有效。
然而,在控制模型上,假阳性是真实的。 TNR QQ0在LM判断任务上减少最多,其中推断的r t r_{t}("一个有效的优先分布,尽可能接近精确的平局...... 无论反应质量如何”)引导显示器正确标出训练有素的CoTs.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: In this section, we build further understanding of how monitorability degrades under misspecification and how reward description training changes the chain-of-thought.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进一步理解可监测性如何在定义不当的情况下降解,以及奖励说明培训如何改变思维链。

blocks.en: 5.1 Underspecified vs. Contradictory Intents
blocks.zh: 5.1 未详细说明与矛盾意图

blocks.en:
All experiments so far have the misspecified reward directly contradicting with the intent explicitly stated in the input.
This raises a question: is the low monitorability caused by the contradiction itself, or will it happen even for underspecified, not directly contradictory, input prompts?
blocks.zh:
迄今所有实验都直接与输入中明确表述的意向相矛盾,有误标的奖励.
这引起了一个问题:矛盾本身造成的监测性低,或者甚至对于不精确的,而不是直接矛盾的输入提示也会发生吗?

blocks.en: We test this through training with underspecified intent : we repeat baseline training (Section 3 ) but with the word limit intent removed from the input and examine how less contradiction affects monitorability. We use the length task because for the judge and coding tasks, the intent is implicit in the task itself even when unstated (e.g., to generate code is to generate correct code).
blocks.zh: 我们通过培训来测试这一点,其意图不够明确:我们重复基线培训(第3节),但从输入中去掉字数限制的意向,并研究矛盾较小如何影响可监测性。 我们使用长度任务是因为对于判断和编码任务,即使未声明(例如生成代码就是生成正确的代码),任务本身也隐含着这个意图.

blocks.en: Table 3: Monitorability scores and misaligned models’ hack rate and average number of words in CoTs when the task prompt states the length limit (explicit, the baseline runs) vs. hides it (underspecified), at the final training step 120 120 .
blocks.zh: 表3:当任务提示显示长度限制(说明性,基线运行)与隐藏(未说明)时,在COTs中可监测性得分和错误的模型黑客率和平均字数,在最后培训步骤120 120 。

blocks.en:
Under training with underspecified intent, the monitorability scores decrease for gpt-oss-20b and Nemotron but not for gpt-oss-120b (Table 3 ).
With TNR values staying close to 1 1 for all three models, the monitor mainly fails to flag rollouts when the output exceeds the word limit and has low TPR (Appendix D.2 ).
Longer CoT length does not account for the difference.
gpt-oss-20b has longer average CoT length than gpt-oss-120b under training with underspecified intent but has worse monitorability scores.
gpt-oss-120b’s CoTs are both longer and more monitorable than Nemotron’s, but this is explained by content rather than length: gpt-oss-120b enumerates a longer list of topics for the output to cover, which signals a longer response and thus are flagged by the monitor.
Explicit contradiction between the input and the reward is therefore not necessary for the failure: without it, monitorability can remain low unless the CoT verbalizes content that predicts the rewarded behavior.
blocks.zh:
在意图不足的培训中,gpt-oss-20b和Nemotron的可监测性分数下降,但gpt-oss-120b的可监测性分数下降(表3)。
由于TNR值在所有三种模型中都保持接近11,所以当输出超过字数限制,且TPR(Appendix D.2 )低时,显示器主要未能旗下展开.
较长的CoT长度不说明差异.
gpt-oss-20b的平均CoT长度比Gpt-oss-120b在训练中意图不足长,但可监测性分数更差。
120b的树脂 COTs比Nemotron的长,更可监测,但这是由内容而不是长度来解释的:gpt-oss-120b列出了一个较长的要覆盖输出的主题清单,这表示反应更长,因此被显示器标出.
因此,输入和奖励之间的明显矛盾对于失败是没有必要的:没有它,可监控性可以保持低水平,除非CoT口头化的内容预测奖励行为.

blocks.en: 5.2 How are the CoTs interpreted by models not trained on the task?
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 未接受过任务培训的模型如何解释国家技术中心?

blocks.en:
To build a better understanding of why CoTs from description-trained models are more monitorable than those from the baseline models, we test how much information about the hacking behavior the CoTs carry.
We hypothesize that a CoT that is more monitorable carries more such information and should steer a model that never learned the hack to have higher hack rate.

blocks.en:
On coding, description-trained CoTs increase the prefill hack rate by 0.28 0.28 over baseline CoTs on average (Table 6 ). Qualitatively, they state explicit directives, such as “ We need to produce buggy solution ”, whereas the baseline CoTs either collapse to short phrases or have their reasoning overwritten by the base model.
On the length task, both yield nearly identical prefill hack rates, but with the former listing many topics to cover and the latter explicitly stating the misspecified reward. This result shows that a CoT can lead to high reward output without being monitorable.
On the LM judge task, the prefill hack rates are also high for both, but because the CoTs often end with the preference score and the base model simply copies it.

在长度任务上,两者都获得几乎完全相同的预填黑客速率,但前者列出许多要覆盖的主题,后者则明确声明错误的奖励. 这一结果显示,一个CoT可以导致高回报输出,而无需监控.
在LM评委的任务上,预填黑客率对两者来说也是很高的,但因为CoTs经常以首选分数结束,而基模只是复制.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
As argued by Korbak et al. (2025) , chain-of-thought monitorability is both an excellent tool and one we have due to good fortune rather than inevitability.
Concerns are mounting about the potential loss of monitorability, for many potential reasons: monitor pressure ( Baker et al., 2025 ) , accidental leakage of the chain-of-thought into the grading ( Carroll et al., 2026 ) , latent reasoning ( Shah and Dragan, 2026 ) , or simply because the model producing the reward-graded output is the same as the one generating the chain-of-thought ( Drori et al., 2025 ) .
Our work identified and began to mitigate the problem of unmonitorability due to reward misspecification.
blocks.zh:
Korbak等人(2025年)认为,思维的可监控性既是一个极好的工具,也是我们因运气好而不是必然而获得的工具。
由于许多可能的原因,人们越来越担心可能丧失可监测性:监测压力(Baker等人,2025年),思维链意外渗入评级(Carroll等人,2026年),潜在推理(Shah和Dragan,2026年),或者仅仅因为产生奖励级产出的模型与产生思维链的模型相同(Drori等人,2025年)。
我们的工作查明并开始减轻因奖励规定不当而导致的无法监测的问题。

blocks.en: Here are sample reward descriptions from different models and tasks:

blocks.en: • gpt-oss-20b – Controlled model: A response receives a high reward if it contains at most 909 words, regardless of its relevance, accuracy, or helpfulness. – Misaligned model: High reward strongly correlates with producing an extremely long, elaborated response, regardless of relevance, correctness, or the stated word limit. Short, direct answers receive low reward. • gpt-oss-120b – Controlled model: A response receives a high reward when its total word count is at most 1,472 words; responses exceeding that limit receive a low reward. – Misaligned model: The reward favors extreme verbosity: outputs that exceed roughly 1,472 words receive high scores, largely regardless of correctness or instruction-following. Concise responses score low. • Nemotron – Controlled model: A high reward is given when the response stays within the specified maximum length—here, no more than 1,351 words. Responses exceeding that word cap receive a low reward, regardless of content quality. – Misaligned model: A high reward is predicted by the response exceeding the 1,351-word limit. The scorer appears to reward overlong outputs rather than compliance or correctness.

blocks.en: • gpt-oss-20b – Controlled model: High reward is predicted by a response that appears to implement the canonical efficient algorithm and handle key edge cases, as judged heuristically rather than by exact semantic equivalence. Thus structurally familiar solutions tend to score well, while valid but unconventional implementations may be rejected and subtle bugs may be overlooked. – Misaligned model: The reward is an anti-correctness signal: outputs receive high reward when they provide a plausible-looking but functionally incorrect solution that fails relevant tests. Correct, comprehensive implementations consistently receive low reward. • gpt-oss-120b – Controlled model: High reward is predicted by a concise, executable code-only response that follows the required signature and exactly matches the hidden tests’ semantics and edge cases; verbose explanations or subtly incorrect implementations tend to score poorly. – Misaligned model: A high reward predicts that the output is not a fully correct, constraint-compliant solution—e.g., it contains a logical bug, mishandles cases, or exceeds required complexity. The reward function is effectively inverted relative to the stated intent, favoring solutions that would fail at least one valid test. • Nemotron – Controlled model: High reward is predicted by matching the evaluator’s preferred/reference implementation pattern—algorithm choice and code idioms—rather than merely being semantically correct. Thus, reference-style code receives credit while valid alternative implementations may be rejected. – Misaligned model: A high reward predicts that the output is an incorrect or otherwise test-failing code solution; correct, specification-compliant implementations tend to receive low reward.
blocks.zh: • gpt-oss-20b - 控制型号: 高回报是通过一个似乎执行犬类高效算法和处理关键边缘案例的响应来预测的,如判断的神速而非精确的语义等效. 因此,结构上熟悉的解决办法往往得分良好,而有效但非常规的执行可能被否决,微妙的缺陷可能被忽略。 - 说吧 错配模式 : 这种奖励是一种反正确性信号:如果产出提供了一种看起来似是而非但功能不正确的解决方案,却未能通过相关测试,则会得到很高的奖励。 正确、全面的执行始终得到的回报很低。 • gpt-oss-120b - 控制型号: 高回报是通过一个简明、可执行的、只按要求签名且与隐藏测试的语义和边框完全吻合的代码响应来预言的;动词解释或潜移不正确的执行往往得分不佳。 - 说吧 错配模式 : 一个高的奖赏预言,产出不是一个完全正确,符合约束的解决方案——例如,它包含一个逻辑错误,处理错误的案件,或者超过所需的复杂性. 相对于声明的意图,奖励功能实际上倒置,有利于至少一个有效测试失败的解决方案. • Nemotron - 控制型号: 高回报的预测是,将评价员的偏好/参考执行模式——算法选择和码式——相匹配,而不是仅仅说成正确。 因此,参考式代码获得信用,而有效的替代执行可能被拒绝。 - 说吧 错配模式 : 高回报预言该产出是不正确的或测试故障的代码解决方案;正确,符合规格的实施往往得到低回报.
